basics.name: Fabio Arnez
basics.label: Research Engineer in AI | Trustworthy/Safe Deep Learning Team Leader | Ph.D. in Computer Science

work.name: CEA-List, Université Paris-Saclay, Laboratory of Embedded and Autonomous Systems (LSEA)
work.position: Research Engineer in AI — Trustworthy/Safe Deep Learning Team Leader
work.summary: Research on DNNs/LLMs/VLMs/VLAs confidence representation (uncertainty estimation) for out-of-distribution/hallucination detection, runtime monitoring in complex computer vision tasks (object detection demo), quantization and embedded uncertainty estimation, safe and robust end-to-end DNN-based UAV navigation, world models, and AI Safety.
highlights: Ph.D. thesis supervision: Deep Neural Network Uncertainty Estimation on Embedded Targets (Aymen Bouguerra, 2024 - present); Out-of-Distribution Detection with Vision Foundation Models and Post-hoc Methods (starting Oct. 2026); internships supervision
Developed RunIA-Core, a Python library for DNN confidence representation and runtime monitoring, with support for PyTorch and PyTorch-Lightning, and integration with MLFlow for experiment tracking

Contributed to the PRIMaL project: developed an uncertainty-based method for LLM extrinsic & intrinsic hallucination detection, developed OoD object detection methods, and collected a dataset for UAV navigation using the PyBullet simulator (gym-pybullet-drones)

Contributing to the DeepGreen project for embedded AI (France 2030 program): developed a dropout operator for the Aidge library for embedded DNN uncertainty estimation, and studied the reliability & robustness of quantized CLIP models
Contributed to the Confiance.ai program (France 2030 program): developed an OoD detection method library

Contributed to the Comp4Drones project (H2020 program, European Union): led WP4-Task 4.4 on UAV runtime monitoring, and developed a distributed uncertainty runtime monitoring system for DNN-based UAV navigation systems
